gloss: account of one's experience; personal story

definitions.gloss: account of one's experience; personal story; firsthand account
definitions.explanation: A story or account based on something the speaker has personally experienced. Often used when someone shares their real-life experiences to inform, advise, or entertain others.

examples.japanese: {経験談|けいけんだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}かせて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{経験談|けいけんだん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{参考|さんこう}→参考：02828_sankou⟧になった。
examples.english: My senior's firsthand account was very helpful.

examples.japanese: ⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{経験談|けいけんだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{載|の}っている→載る：27882_noru⟧。
examples.english: There are many personal accounts of studying abroad posted online.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧ (experience) + {談|だん} (talk, story). The suffix {談|だん} appears in many compound words for types of stories or accounts.

- {経験談|けいけんだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{語|かた}る→語る：01930_kataru⟧: to tell about one's experience
- {経験談|けいけんだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧: to hear someone's experience
- {経験談|けいけんだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{共有|きょうゆう}する→共有する：19639_kyouyuusuru⟧: to share one's experience
- ⟦{貴重|きちょう}→貴重：00223_kichou⟧な{経験談|けいけんだん}: a valuable personal account
